download_images_from_urls: download images from a list of URLs using WebDocumentExtractor with configurable thread count
create_image_dataset: create a dataset from downloaded images using WebDocumentExtractor with sharding support
run_image_pipeline: run the full image download and dataset creation pipeline for a given job index
download_images_only: download images without creating a dataset by setting the download_only flag to 1
sync_dataset_to_s3: sync the created image dataset and URL index map to an S3 bucket
